title: One Pan Blanket Dumplings
description: The quickest and easiest way to make homemade dumplings: mounds of seasoned pork covered with dumpling wrappers and steamed in one pan. On the table in under 25 minutes.
ingredients: [{"quantity":"455","unit":"g","name":"ground pork"},{"quantity":"30","unit":"g","name":"green onions, thinly sliced"},{"quantity":"1","unit":"tbsp","name":"fresh ginger, grated"},{"quantity":"4","unit":"cloves","name":"garlic, minced"},{"quantity":"1","unit":"tbsp","name":"oyster sauce"},{"quantity":"1","unit":"tsp","name":"black pepper"},{"quantity":"2","unit":"tbsp","name":"chili crisp"},{"quantity":"3","unit":"tbsp","name":"soy sauce"},{"quantity":"1 1/2","unit":"tsp","name":"sesame oil"},{"quantity":"1","unit":"tbsp","name":"rice vinegar"},{"quantity":"18-20","unit":"","name":"dumpling or wonton wrappers"},{"quantity":"60","unit":"ml","name":"chicken broth"},{"quantity":"","unit":"","name":"Avocado oil"},{"quantity":"","unit":"","name":"Soy sauce, for topping"},{"quantity":"","unit":"","name":"Chili crisp, for topping"},{"quantity":"","unit":"","name":"Green onions, sliced, for topping"},{"quantity":"","unit":"","name":"Sesame seeds, for topping"}]
instructions: ["In a bowl, combine the ground pork, green onions, grated ginger, garlic, oyster sauce, black pepper, chili crisp, soy sauce, sesame oil and rice vinegar. Mix until fully combined.","Use a cookie scoop to place mounds of the filling into a large pan with a lid, leaving some space between each one.","Place a dumpling wrapper over each mound and pinch the edges around the filling to seal.","Drizzle with avocado oil and pour in the chicken broth. Cover and steam over medium heat for 10 minutes, or until the pork reaches an internal temperature of 71°C.","Top with soy sauce, chili crisp, green onions and sesame seeds, and serve with a side of rice."]
translations: {"nl":{"title":"Dekendumplings uit één pan","description":"De snelste en makkelijkste manier om zelf dumplings te maken: bergjes gekruid varkensgehakt, afgedekt met dumplingvellen en in één pan gestoomd. In minder dan 25 minuten op tafel.","ingredients":[{"quantity":"455","unit":"g","name":"varkensgehakt"},{"quantity":"30","unit":"g","name":"lente-ui, in dunne ringetjes"},{"quantity":"1","unit":"el","name":"verse gember, geraspt"},{"quantity":"4","unit":"teentjes","name":"knoflook, fijngehakt"},{"quantity":"1","unit":"el","name":"oestersaus"},{"quantity":"1","unit":"tl","name":"zwarte peper"},{"quantity":"2","unit":"el","name":"chili crisp"},{"quantity":"3","unit":"el","name":"sojasaus"},{"quantity":"1 1/2","unit":"tl","name":"sesamolie"},{"quantity":"1","unit":"el","name":"rijstazijn"},{"quantity":"18-20","unit":"","name":"dumpling- of wontonvellen"},{"quantity":"60","unit":"ml","name":"kippenbouillon"},{"quantity":"","unit":"","name":"Avocado-olie"},{"quantity":"","unit":"","name":"Sojasaus, voor erover"},{"quantity":"","unit":"","name":"Chili crisp, voor erover"},{"quantity":"","unit":"","name":"Lente-ui, in ringetjes, voor erover"},{"quantity":"","unit":"","name":"Sesamzaad, voor erover"}],"instructions":["Meng in een kom het varkensgehakt met de lente-ui, geraspte gember, knoflook, oestersaus, zwarte peper, chili crisp, sojasaus, sesamolie en rijstazijn tot alles goed gemengd is.","Schep met een ijsschep bergjes vulling in een grote pan met deksel; laat wat ruimte tussen de bergjes.","Leg op elk bergje een dumplingvel en druk de randen rond de vulling goed dicht.","Besprenkel met avocado-olie en giet de kippenbouillon erbij. Leg de deksel op de pan en stoom 10 minuten op matig vuur, of tot het gehakt een kerntemperatuur van 71 °C heeft.","Schep er sojasaus en chili crisp over, bestrooi met lente-ui en sesamzaad en serveer met rijst."],"notes":"Het recept levert 18-20 dumplings op."}}

title: Korean BBQ Beef Kabobs
description: Street food at home: thin layers of seasoned ground beef stacked between flour tortillas, threaded onto skewers, fried until crispy and glazed with a sweet and savory BBQ sauce.
ingredients: [{"quantity":"455","unit":"g","name":"ground beef"},{"quantity":"2","unit":"tbsp","name":"soy sauce (for the beef)"},{"quantity":"1","unit":"tsp","name":"sesame oil (for the beef)"},{"quantity":"1/2","unit":"tbsp","name":"gochujang"},{"quantity":"1/2","unit":"","name":"onion, grated"},{"quantity":"2","unit":"cloves","name":"garlic, grated"},{"quantity":"2","unit":"tsp","name":"fresh ginger, grated"},{"quantity":"1","unit":"","name":"green onion, greens only, finely chopped"},{"quantity":"2","unit":"tbsp","name":"soy sauce (for the sauce)"},{"quantity":"2","unit":"tbsp","name":"Japanese BBQ sauce"},{"quantity":"1","unit":"tbsp","name":"rice vinegar"},{"quantity":"1","unit":"tbsp","name":"brown sugar"},{"quantity":"1","unit":"tsp","name":"sesame oil (for the sauce)"},{"quantity":"1/4","unit":"tsp","name":"white pepper"},{"quantity":"","unit":"","name":"Flour tortillas"},{"quantity":"2","unit":"tbsp","name":"canola oil"},{"quantity":"","unit":"","name":"Wooden skewers"}]
instructions: ["In a bowl, combine the ground beef with the soy sauce, sesame oil and gochujang. Grate in the onion, garlic and ginger, add the chopped green onion greens and mix well with your hands.","For the sauce, whisk together the soy sauce, Japanese BBQ sauce, rice vinegar, brown sugar, sesame oil and white pepper in a small bowl.","Stack the tortillas and trim off the round edges so you're left with squares.","Spread a thin, even layer of the beef mixture over a tortilla square and top with another square. Repeat, pressing each layer down, until the beef is used up. Finish with a tortilla.","Cut the stack into thick blocks. Turn them on their side and thread them onto skewers, pressing the blocks together into one long kabob.","Heat the canola oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Fry the kabobs, turning with tongs, until crispy and browned on all sides and the beef is cooked through.","Brush the kabobs with the sauce and turn them a few times in the pan to glaze.","Serve over rice, topped with sliced green onion and a drizzle of spicy mayo if you like."]
translations: {"nl":{"title":"Koreaanse BBQ-rundvleesspiesen","description":"Streetfood thuis: dunne laagjes gekruid rundergehakt tussen tarwetortilla's, aan spiesen geregen, krokant gebakken en geglazuurd met een zoet-hartige barbecuesaus.","ingredients":[{"quantity":"455","unit":"g","name":"rundergehakt"},{"quantity":"2","unit":"el","name":"sojasaus (voor het gehakt)"},{"quantity":"1","unit":"tl","name":"sesamolie (voor het gehakt)"},{"quantity":"1/2","unit":"el","name":"gochujang"},{"quantity":"1/2","unit":"","name":"ui, geraspt"},{"quantity":"2","unit":"teentjes","name":"knoflook, geraspt"},{"quantity":"2","unit":"tl","name":"verse gember, geraspt"},{"quantity":"1","unit":"","name":"lente-ui, alleen het groen, fijngehakt"},{"quantity":"2","unit":"el","name":"sojasaus (voor de saus)"},{"quantity":"2","unit":"el","name":"Japanse barbecuesaus"},{"quantity":"1","unit":"el","name":"rijstazijn"},{"quantity":"1","unit":"el","name":"bruine suiker"},{"quantity":"1","unit":"tl","name":"sesamolie (voor de saus)"},{"quantity":"1/4","unit":"tl","name":"witte peper"},{"quantity":"","unit":"","name":"Tarwetortilla's"},{"quantity":"2","unit":"el","name":"koolzaadolie"},{"quantity":"","unit":"","name":"Houten spiesen"}],"instructions":["Meng in een kom het rundergehakt met de sojasaus, sesamolie en gochujang. Rasp de ui, knoflook en gember erboven, voeg het gehakte groen van de lente-ui toe en kneed alles goed door elkaar.","Klop voor de saus in een kommetje de sojasaus, Japanse barbecuesaus, rijstazijn, bruine suiker, sesamolie en witte peper door elkaar.","Leg de tortilla's op een stapel en snijd de ronde randen eraf, zodat je vierkanten overhoudt.","Smeer een dunne, gelijkmatige laag van het gehaktmengsel op een tortillavierkant en leg er een tweede vierkant op. Herhaal dit tot het gehakt op is en druk elke laag goed aan. Eindig met een tortilla.","Snijd de stapel in dikke blokken. Leg ze op hun kant en rijg ze aan de spiesen; druk de blokken tegen elkaar zodat er één lange spies ontstaat.","Verhit de koolzaadolie in een grote koekenpan op middelhoog vuur. Bak de spiesen rondom krokant en bruin en tot het gehakt gaar is; keer ze met een tang.","Bestrijk de spiesen met de saus en keer ze nog een paar keer in de pan, zodat ze mooi glanzen.","Serveer op rijst, met gesneden lente-ui en eventueel wat pittige mayonaise erover."],"notes":null}}

title: Teriyaki Noodles
description: These teriyaki noodles are a quick & easy dinner and only take about 20 minutes to make! Keep it plant-based or add chicken, salmon or another protein of your choice. Fresh, flavorful & perfect for busy nights.
ingredients: [{"quantity":"340","unit":"g","name":"brown rice noodles (or any kind of noodle)"},{"quantity":"140","unit":"g","name":"mushrooms, sliced (shiitake, baby bella, etc.)"},{"quantity":"150","unit":"g","name":"bok choy or kale, chopped"},{"quantity":"3","unit":"cloves","name":"garlic, minced"},{"quantity":"1","unit":"tbsp","name":"fresh ginger, grated"},{"quantity":"25","unit":"g","name":"green onion, chopped (mostly the white part; save the green for serving)"},{"quantity":"80","unit":"ml","name":"low-sodium soy sauce or tamari"},{"quantity":"2","unit":"tbsp","name":"water or vegetable broth"},{"quantity":"2","unit":"tsp","name":"toasted sesame oil"},{"quantity":"1","unit":"tbsp","name":"rice vinegar"},{"quantity":"1","unit":"tbsp","name":"coconut or brown sugar (or more to taste)"},{"quantity":"2-3","unit":"tbsp","name":"honey (or maple syrup for vegan)"},{"quantity":"1/4","unit":"tsp","name":"red pepper flakes"},{"quantity":"1","unit":"tbsp","name":"cornstarch"},{"quantity":"","unit":"","name":"Neutral oil, for frying"}]
instructions: ["Cook the noodles according to the package instructions.","Meanwhile, mince the garlic and grate the ginger. Add them to a pan with a little neutral oil (such as olive oil), along with the chopped green onion. Sauté for about 3 minutes, until lightly golden brown.","Add the sliced mushrooms and chopped bok choy and sauté for about 5-7 minutes, until wilted.","Meanwhile, whisk together the soy sauce, water or vegetable broth, sesame oil, vinegar, sugar, honey, red pepper flakes and cornstarch in a small dish or cup.","Combine the vegetables with the noodles, pour the sauce on top and stir to coat. Let simmer for about 5 minutes to thicken and let the flavors blend.","Taste and adjust as desired (more soy sauce makes it saucier and saltier). Serve warm, topped with the chopped green onion tops."]
notes: Serve as is, or add chicken, salmon or another protein of your choice. Use tamari for a gluten-free version.
translations: {"nl":{"title":"Teriyaki-noedels","description":"Deze teriyaki-noedels zijn een snel en makkelijk avondeten en staan in zo'n 20 minuten op tafel! Houd ze plantaardig of voeg kip, zalm of een andere eiwitbron naar keuze toe. Fris, vol smaak en perfect voor drukke avonden.","ingredients":[{"quantity":"340","unit":"g","name":"zilvervliesrijstnoedels (of een ander soort noedels)"},{"quantity":"140","unit":"g","name":"champignons, in plakjes (shiitake, kastanjechampignons, enz.)"},{"quantity":"150","unit":"g","name":"paksoi of boerenkool, gehakt"},{"quantity":"3","unit":"teentjes","name":"knoflook, fijngehakt"},{"quantity":"1","unit":"el","name":"verse gember, geraspt"},{"quantity":"25","unit":"g","name":"lente-ui, gehakt (vooral het witte deel; bewaar het groen om te serveren)"},{"quantity":"80","unit":"ml","name":"zoutarme sojasaus of tamari"},{"quantity":"2","unit":"el","name":"water of groentebouillon"},{"quantity":"2","unit":"tl","name":"geroosterde sesamolie"},{"quantity":"1","unit":"el","name":"rijstazijn"},{"quantity":"1","unit":"el","name":"kokosbloesemsuiker of bruine suiker (of meer naar smaak)"},{"quantity":"2-3","unit":"el","name":"honing (of ahornsiroop voor een veganistische versie)"},{"quantity":"1/4","unit":"tl","name":"chilivlokken"},{"quantity":"1","unit":"el","name":"maïzena"},{"quantity":"","unit":"","name":"Neutrale olie, om in te bakken"}],"instructions":["Kook de noedels volgens de aanwijzingen op de verpakking.","Hak intussen de knoflook fijn en rasp de gember. Doe ze samen met de gehakte lente-ui in een pan met een beetje neutrale olie (bijvoorbeeld olijfolie). Bak ongeveer 3 minuten, tot alles lichtgoudbruin is.","Voeg de champignons en de gehakte paksoi toe en bak ongeveer 5-7 minuten, tot de groenten geslonken zijn.","Klop intussen in een klein kommetje of bekertje de sojasaus, het water of de groentebouillon, de sesamolie, de azijn, de suiker, de honing, de chilivlokken en de maïzena door elkaar.","Meng de groenten met de noedels, giet de saus erover en schep alles goed om. Laat ongeveer 5 minuten zachtjes pruttelen, zodat de saus indikt en de smaken goed samenkomen.","Proef en breng op smaak (met extra sojasaus wordt het lekker smeuïg en zouter). Serveer warm, met het gehakte groen van de lente-ui erover."],"notes":"Lekker zo, of voeg kip, zalm of een andere eiwitbron naar keuze toe. Gebruik tamari voor een glutenvrije versie."}}

title: Walnut Sauce (Salsa di Noci)
description: A rich, creamy Ligurian sauce of toasted ground walnuts, garlic, white wine, chicken stock and cream. Traditionally served with pansotti, and great with ravioli, especially ones with a bitter-greens filling.
ingredients: [{"quantity":"30","unit":"g","name":"unsalted butter"},{"quantity":"1","unit":"clove","name":"garlic (medium), minced"},{"quantity":"60","unit":"g","name":"raw walnuts (black walnuts or other nuts), ground in a spice grinder"},{"quantity":"60","unit":"ml","name":"dry white wine"},{"quantity":"1/2","unit":"","name":"chicken stock cube, dissolved in a small cup of water"},{"quantity":"60","unit":"ml","name":"heavy cream"},{"quantity":"","unit":"","name":"Salt, to taste"},{"quantity":"","unit":"","name":"Freshly cooked ravioli or pansotti, to serve"},{"quantity":"","unit":"","name":"Pasta cooking water, to loosen the sauce"}]
instructions: ["Grind the walnuts in a spice grinder, and dissolve the half stock cube in a small cup of hot water.","Melt the butter in a saucepan with the garlic and cook for about a minute.","Add the ground walnuts and cook until the mixture foams and the nuts start to turn golden.","Add the white wine and the dissolved stock and reduce by half.","Stir in the cream and simmer briefly until thickened.","Add the cooked ravioli, check the seasoning and serve immediately. If the sauce gets too thick from the starch in the nuts, loosen it with a splash of pasta cooking water."]
notes: Almost any nut or seed that can be ground works in place of the black walnuts. Add corn starch to thicken the sauce to your liking.
translations: {"nl":{"title":"Walnotensaus (Salsa di Noci)","description":"Een rijke, romige Ligurische saus van geroosterde gemalen walnoten, knoflook, witte wijn, kippenbouillon en room. Traditioneel geserveerd bij pansotti, en heerlijk bij ravioli, vooral met een vulling van bittere bladgroenten.","ingredients":[{"quantity":"30","unit":"g","name":"ongezouten boter"},{"quantity":"1","unit":"teentje","name":"knoflook (middelgroot), fijngehakt"},{"quantity":"60","unit":"g","name":"rauwe walnoten (zwarte walnoten of andere noten), gemalen in een kruidenmolen"},{"quantity":"60","unit":"ml","name":"droge witte wijn"},{"quantity":"1/2","unit":"","name":"kippenbouillonblokje, opgelost in een klein kopje water"},{"quantity":"60","unit":"ml","name":"room"},{"quantity":"","unit":"","name":"Zout, naar smaak"},{"quantity":"","unit":"","name":"Vers gekookte ravioli of pansotti, om te serveren"},{"quantity":"","unit":"","name":"Kookwater van de pasta, om de saus losser te maken"}],"instructions":["Maal de walnoten in een kruidenmolen en los het halve bouillonblokje op in een klein kopje heet water.","Smelt de boter met de knoflook in een steelpan en bak ongeveer een minuut.","Voeg de gemalen walnoten toe en bak tot het mengsel schuimt en de noten goudbruin beginnen te kleuren.","Voeg de witte wijn en de opgeloste bouillon toe en laat tot de helft inkoken.","Roer de room erdoor en laat kort sudderen tot de saus is ingedikt.","Voeg de gekookte ravioli toe, proef of de saus op smaak is en serveer meteen. Wordt de saus te dik door het zetmeel in de noten? Maak hem dan losser met een scheutje kookwater van de pasta."],"notes":"In plaats van zwarte walnoten kun je bijna elke noot of elk zaad gebruiken dat zich laat malen. Voeg maïzena toe om de saus naar wens te binden."}}

title: Thai Peanut Chicken
description: This delicious Thai Peanut Chicken is positively PACKED with flavor! Quick and easy to make and thoroughly satisfying!
ingredients: [{"quantity":"2","unit":"tbsp","name":"cooking oil"},{"quantity":"1","unit":"","name":"yellow onion, chopped"},{"quantity":"2","unit":"cloves","name":"garlic, minced"},{"quantity":"2.5","unit":"cm piece","name":"ginger root, minced"},{"quantity":"455","unit":"g","name":"chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces"},{"quantity":"4","unit":"tbsp","name":"sweet chili sauce"},{"quantity":"3","unit":"tbsp","name":"tomato sauce or ketchup"},{"quantity":"4","unit":"tbsp","name":"peanut butter"},{"quantity":"1","unit":"tbsp","name":"chili powder"},{"quantity":"1","unit":"tsp","name":"dark brown sugar (optional)"},{"quantity":"396","unit":"g","name":"unsweetened coconut milk"},{"quantity":"1","unit":"tsp","name":"salt"},{"quantity":"","unit":"","name":"Chopped fresh cilantro for garnish"},{"quantity":"","unit":"","name":"Chopped roasted peanuts for garnish"}]
instructions: ["Heat the oil in skillet over medium-high heat and cook the onions until soft and translucent, 5 minutes. Add the garlic and ginger and cook for another 2 minutes. Add the chicken and cook for 3-4 minutes.","Add the sweet chili sauce, tomato sauce or ketchup, chili powder, peanut butter, and sugar and stir to combine.","Add the coconut milk and salt and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to medium-low, cover and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. If the sauce is too thin for your liking, dissolve a tablespoon of cornstarch in 2 tablespoons of water, stir it into the sauce, and simmer or another minute until thickened. Add salt to taste.","Serve over steamed rice garnished with cilantro and chopped roasted peanuts."]
translations: {"nl":{"title":"Thaise pindakip","description":"Deze heerlijke Thaise pindakip zit echt BOMVOL smaak! Snel en makkelijk te maken en heerlijk vullend!","ingredients":[{"quantity":"2","unit":"el","name":"bakolie"},{"quantity":"1","unit":"","name":"gele ui, gesnipperd"},{"quantity":"2","unit":"teentjes","name":"knoflook, fijngehakt"},{"quantity":"2,5","unit":"cm","name":"verse gember, fijngehakt"},{"quantity":"455","unit":"g","name":"kipfilet, in hapklare stukjes"},{"quantity":"4","unit":"el","name":"zoete chilisaus"},{"quantity":"3","unit":"el","name":"tomatensaus of ketchup"},{"quantity":"4","unit":"el","name":"pindakaas"},{"quantity":"1","unit":"el","name":"chilipoeder"},{"quantity":"1","unit":"tl","name":"donkerbruine suiker (optioneel)"},{"quantity":"396","unit":"g","name":"ongezoete kokosmelk"},{"quantity":"1","unit":"tl","name":"zout"},{"quantity":"","unit":"","name":"Gehakte verse koriander, voor de garnering"},{"quantity":"","unit":"","name":"Gehakte geroosterde pinda's, voor de garnering"}],"instructions":["Verhit de olie in een koekenpan op middelhoog vuur en bak de ui in 5 minuten zacht en glazig. Voeg de knoflook en gember toe en bak nog 2 minuten. Voeg de kip toe en bak 3-4 minuten.","Voeg de zoete chilisaus, tomatensaus of ketchup, chilipoeder, pindakaas en suiker toe en roer alles goed door.","Voeg de kokosmelk en het zout toe en breng aan de kook.
